ITEM 1 | Large mass of white, opaque, crumbly curd-like pieces with irregular rough edges, piled in a loose heap covering the upper-left portion of the plate, roughly 12-13 cm across and 2-3 cm tall, slightly moist-looking with no sheen, holds a rough mound shape | 230
ITEM 2 | Dark red-purple grapes, whole, smooth glossy skins, clustered in a group of about 9-10 berries on the right side of the plate next to the white mass, each roughly 1.5-2 cm in diameter, one with a small stem remnant | 75
ITEM 3 | Orange cubed pieces with browned, slightly caramelized edges and soft-looking interiors, roughly 2-3 cm pieces, arranged in a cluster across the lower-left and center of the plate, some pieces darker brown at edges, with a few darker reddish-brown chunks mixed in, covering about 25% of the plate | 150
ITEM 4 | Larger orange wedge-shaped pieces with flat cut faces and slightly glossy, moist surfaces, about 3-4 cm long, clustered at the lower-right edge of the plate beside the cubed pieces, with a small amount of orange residue or juice on the plate | 120
